Gladiator mounts are unique mounts tied to rated arenas. Since Warlords Season 1, they're obtained by earning the Gladiator title during their respective PvP season. From season 1 to season 15, they were instead granted to the top 0.5% of arena teams at the end of their respective PvP season. There is no way to earn previous seasons' gladiator mounts. Most gladiator mounts are dragons of some kind. The only exceptions so far are the gronnlings from , the soul eaters from , and the felbats from .

Gladiator gear is the long-standing Rated PvP gear set that can be purchased from Conquest Quartermasters with Conquest. Originally, it was the only PvP set available, which was purchasable by different currency over the years (Arena Points, Conquest Points, etc.). During , , and , Gladiator gear was purchasable from honor quartermasters and the conquest quartermasters, however the honor quartermasters offered the previous season's Gladiator gear instead (except for the first season of the expansion offering a completely new set). It was previously Aurius Rivendare's skeletal steed, Shadowmane. After Rivendare's death, a death knight named Raemien the Soultaker claimed the horse for himself. Grayson Shadowbreaker and the new Highlord of the Silver Hand defeated Raemien, subdued Shadowmane, and brought it back to Light's Hope Chapel where they purified it.
